installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# n8n install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -e
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR

cd /mnt/server

if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
    cat > package.json <<'EOF'
{
  "name": "n8n-server",
  "private": true
}
EOF
fi

VERSION=${N8N_VERSION:-latest}
echo "Installing n8n@${VERSION}, this takes a few minutes"
npm install --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error "n8n@${VERSION}"

./node_modules/.bin/n8n --version

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "n8n installed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"
